author: More Perfect Union
description:
North Dakota could be the next state to pass universal school lunches.

The state went for Trump by 37% in 2024, but next week voters will be able to directly choose to feed kids at school.

Supporters say it's not a liberal or conservative issue, but a human issue. And with prices going up and up, Measure 2 could change the lives of hungry kids.

Host: Jax Ajueny-James
Editor: Andrew Rivera
Producer: Victoria Hammett
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
